reviews.comment: Marion and Sean are a great team! They were able to resolve my issue quickly and professionally. We use them for our business and personal computer needs, and highly recommend SatCom to others.
Satcom & Computers provides excellent customer service, prompt responses and resolutions to technical issues.  Staff friendliness is also a plus!
SatCom is reliable, responds quickly, and makes sure all issues are resolved
Outstanding service. Very professional and dependable
very attentive, resourceful and capable, and helps immediately!
